name: Race
overview: Scripture reveals that all humanity shares a common origin and Father, as Malachi 2:10 reminds us that one God created us all, emphasizing the unity of the human race. This unity is further expressed in the call to love one another as Jesus commanded in John 13:34, transcending divisions among people. The Great Commission in Matthew 28:19 underscores the inclusiveness of the gospel, calling believers to disciple all nations without distinction. Additionally, the concept of 'race' is used figuratively in passages like Psalms 19:5 and Ecclesiastes 9:11, illustrating life’s challenges as a race or contest where success is not guaranteed by strength or speed alone.
